name: Kurwitu Ventures Ltd
source: Kurwitu Ventures Ltd financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2020 | NSEBLOCKED 17 Nov 2026: the shares have been suspended since 2017 for non-compliance and the company applied to leave the NSE in April 2023. The newest audited accounts on the Capital Markets Authority archive are the six months to 30 June 2022, a shortened period after the change from a December year end: https://annualreport.cma.or.ke/media/INVESTMENT/Kurwitu%20Ventures%20Ltd/documents/2022.PDF. No later filing exists, so the FY2021 year is the last full-year audited set.
source_note: Absolute Kenya Shillings (Shillings). Group (consolidated). 2020 investing activities are nil; financing is proceeds from shareholders loans.
